name: @pyreon/example-native-showcase
description: PRIVATE / EXPERIMENTAL — Today, a small todo app written once in src/TodayApp.tsx and built for the web (index.html + vite), iOS / SwiftUI (ios/) and Android / Jetpack Compose (android/) from this one directory, the layout create-multiplatform scaffolds.

scripts.build: vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.ts --outDir dist-server && bun scripts/prerender.ts
